title: Duel Decks: Elves vs. Inventors: card flavor text

entities.name: Ezuri
entities.description: A legendary figure whose legacy is debated: great hero or grand betrayer.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who speaks of life growing everywhere and of her kin finding where it grows strongest.

entities.name: Kujar
entities.description: An elvish place where every leaf, tree and building is placed for maximum harmony.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: An elvish philosophy of harmony that governs the layout of Kujar.

entities.name: Eidren
entities.description: The perfect of Lys Alana, who had hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a pattern he deemed beautiful.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: An elvish realm ruled by its perfect, Eidren.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: A forest born when Eidren rearranged hundreds of uprooted trees.

entities.name: Talara
entities.description: A safewright who protects a delicate woodland waterfall.

entities.name: The Invokers' Tales
entities.description: An in-world writing warning that life dangles on the brink of extinction.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: A plane whose artificers strive for perfection, progress and elegance.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: A people who see the artificer as an archaeologist uncovering hidden truth, known for curiosity and duplicity.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A figure whose war machines the elves fought.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A fighter for the freedom to unleash the fires of invention.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A planeswalker who vows to fight forever and laments that the heart of his world has succumbed.

entities.name: Chammi
entities.description: A curio vendor hawking gifts.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Grand Cenobite, who proclaims that the glorious infection has taken hold.

entities.name: Mycosynth
entities.description: A substance created by the oil that in turn created New Phyrexia.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: A world created by the mycosynth.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Beings for whom death is neither an end nor a one-time occurrence.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A sprawling plane some hope to escape with voyager staffs.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker whom automatons turned to face around a foundry.

entities.name: Kuldotha
entities.description: A wellspring of molten metal and temple of the goblin horde.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: Site of the Knowledge Pool and source of vedalken arcana.

entities.name: Knowledge Pool
entities.description: A site located in Lumengrid.

events.summary: Eidren, perfect of Lys Alana, ordered hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged, creating the Gilt-Leaf Wood.
events.quote: Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.

events.summary: Talara vows to send waves of warriors against any who disturb the waterfall she protects.
events.quote: She has vowed to send wave after wave of warriors to slay any who would dare disturb its beauty.

events.summary: The elves fought Memnarch's war machines and were confounded when one was thrown at them.
events.quote: The elves had devised countless strategies to combat Memnarch's war machines

events.summary: Automatons around a foundry unhitch and turn to face Chandra.
events.quote: automatons unhitched themselves from their mounts and pivoted to face Chandra.

events.summary: Elesh Norn declares the Phyrexian infection has taken hold.
Koth laments that even the heart of his world has succumbed.
events.quote: "So even the heart of our world has succumbed."

relations.quote: Thus the Gilt-Leaf Wood was born.
Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool

relations.note: Kujar is laid out according to the Great Conduit philosophy
relations.quote: in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.
